name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: US–Iran war continues under a naval blockade; Doha talks paused with no breakthrough
state: The war that began with US–Israeli strikes on Iran on 28 Feb continues with a US naval blockade and attacks on Gulf shipping; two tankers hit mines in Hormuz on 1 Nov. Qatari-mediated talks ended on 1 Nov without a breakthrough and a draft proposal is circulating; Trump has said there will be no new attack before the 3 Nov midterms (Reuters, 2 Nov). Israeli strikes in Gaza continue despite the ceasefire.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to much of the region; follow its travel advice and airline updates.
rubric_hit: Active interstate war with attacks on shipping = Alert

sources.title: Reuters via Investing.com — Iranians have left Doha talks, draft proposal for US deal being circulated

why: Conflict involving Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen threatens civilians, shipping and wider escalation. Direct hostilities with Iran are tracked under Gulf / US–Iran war.
drivers: Ceasefire status, Iran-linked groups, hostage talks, humanitarian access, US posture.

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
